scope: Dn shift/rotate vectors for ROXL/ROXR (byte, word, long) and ASL.l: initial/final registers, prefetch, listed RAM and ordered bus transactions. Native and reference paths.
selection: Deterministic, from inputs only: register-count forms with a count (mod 64) of 0, 31, 32, 63 or a multiple of the ROX period, plus every 2nd other one; immediate-count forms every 4th; memory forms and trace-bit vectors excluded; code windows must fit the harness image. See tools/build_m68000_shift_fixture.py.
excluded: Memory-operand shifts, trace-bit vectors, everything outside the seven groups, odd-address and bus errors. Register-count vectors are compared with their clocks (6 + 2n, 8 + 2n for a long, n the count modulo 64).
